messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: 4 nodes NotReady in infer-usw1. Affected pool: infer-usw1-pool. Error rate on /v1/generate up ~28%. Paging #eng-oncall. Incident ID: INC-2026-1487

pd_bot: Page sent to @ryan_oncall (primary). Escalation started :rotating_light:

ryan_oncall: ack — I'm on it. Pulling dashboards and logs now.

jess_sre: I see repeated kubelet restarts on infer-usw1-n-03 and infer-usw1-n-07. journalctl around restart shows 'kernel: Out of memory' followed by 'nvidia: GPU reset' entries.

maya_infra: cordoning n-03 and n-07 now. Doing drains in small batches to avoid broad disruption.

ryan_oncall: steering traffic: enabling fallback routing to infer-usw1-fallback and scaling dedicated-gpu-queue +2. @olivia_pm FYI for customer comms.

olivia_pm: noted. Are customers seeing visible errors or just latency? @luis_support?

luis_support: AcmeAds reported spikes of 504/502 between 11:05-11:12 UTC, ticket #12345. A few other customers reporting elevated latency.

jess_sre: Logs (snippet):
```
$ kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep model-server
model-srv-abc-1  Running  2/3  0  11m  infer-usw1-n-07

# journalctl -u kubelet -n 40 | tail -n 20
Apr 10 11:05:22 infer-usw1-n-07 kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 32145 (model-server) score 987 or sacrifice child
Apr 10 11:05:22 infer-usw1-n-07 kernel: oom_reaper: reaped process 32145
Apr 10 11:05:23 infer-usw1-n-07 nvidia: GPU reset detected on GPU0
Apr 10 11:05:24 infer-usw1-n-07 kubelet: NodeController detected NotReady for node infer-usw1-n-07
```

jess_sre: Workaround plan: restart kubelet on n-07 (systemctl restart kubelet) and monitor. If driver resets persist, escalate to full node reboot.

maya_infra: cordon applied to infer-usw1-n-03. Draining now:
`kubectl cordon infer-usw1-n-03 && kubectl drain infer-usw1-n-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60`

ryan_oncall: applying taint to keep new inference pods off n-07 until stable: `kubectl taint nodes infer-usw1-n-07 unstable=true:NoSchedule`

jess_sre: runtime logs show OOMKill in model-server container: "OOMKilled signal 9". Pattern looks like long sequences + KV cache pressure. Temporary fix: increase pod memory on fallback pool and drop long-seq requests to reduce pressure.

ryan_oncall: traffic shift executed: ~85% -> fallback, 15% -> original pool. Dedicated queue scaled +2. Watching latency & error rates.

maya_infra: rebooting infer-usw1-n-07 (soft reboot) — ETA ~3m. Will mark ready only after full health checks pass.

olivia_pm: posting customer status: short note sent — "We are mitigating an infrastructure issue affecting some requests; traffic is being routed to fallback capacity. We will update in 15 minutes."

jess_sre: if driver resets repeat after reboot, we should repro on a lab node with the same kernel + driver combo. Assigning follow-up: @jess_sre + @maya_infra for postmortem and kernel/driver triage.

ryan_oncall: handing off to night-shift at 11:30 UTC. Follow-ups for handoff: collect dmesg, full kubelet logs, pod memory profiles, and recent model-server core dumps. Leaving channel open for 30m, then will close when stable. :thumbsup:
